cache_metric_scope: Source-trace theoretical prefix-reuse fields only; not actual H200 cache residency or cache-read telemetry.
method_notes: Rows are existing h200_requests_profiled.parquet records with concurrency=8 (profiling, no error/cancellation, valid required metrics). Existing aggregate_validation.csv validates c8 request count/input/output and latency aggregates. TTFT percentiles use pandas linear interpolation. weighted_ITL=sum(ITL_ms*(output_tokens-1))/sum(output_tokens-1) over output_tokens>1 and ITL_ms>0; wall span=min start to max end.
unknowns: input_sequence_length_total is AIPerf input_tokens and is not verified as logical prompt length. No explicit actual cache-read/load/store tokens, physical KV allocation, or per-request cache-hit telemetry is available.
